title: Marston load on rigid conduits in trench condition

symbols.definition: Load on the pipe in kg per linear meter
Unit weight of backfill soil in kg/m³
Width of trench at the top of the pipe in m and
Load coefficient which is a function of a ratio of height of fill to width of trench (H/B_d) and of the friction coefficient between the backfill and the sides of the trench.

applicability: Rigid conduits in trench condition. Weights of common filling materials (w) and values of C_d for common soil conditions are given in Tables 3.18 and 3.19 respectively.
